summary: Iteration 29 testing completed for 14 major enhancements. All 35 backend tests passed. All frontend pages verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 tested 14 major enhancements: 1) Advanced Analytics page with charts and stats, 2) Report Builder with CRUD and Excel export, 3) Volunteer Scheduling with shift management, 4) Email Templates with variable support, 5) Financial APIs management, 6) GDPR Settings with data export, 7) 2FA setup in Settings Security tab, 8) Multi-language support (Luganda and Thai available in dropdown). All navigation items visible in sidebar under Analytics, Operations, and Admin sections.

advanced_analytics.details: Page loads with stat cards (Total Members, Events, Check-ins, Net Financial), Monthly Trends chart, Financial Trends chart, Member Growth chart, Location breakdown, Outreach Impact section

report_builder.details: Create Report dialog with Title, Type (Members/Financial/Events/Attendance/Custom), Schedule, Filters (Location, Status, Date range), Share toggle, Auto-Update toggle. Generate and Export to Excel buttons work.

volunteer_scheduling.details: Create Shift dialog with Title, Date, Role, Start/End Time, Location, Slots, Linked Event, Notes. All Shifts/My Shifts tabs. Assign Volunteer functionality.

email_templates.details: Default templates seeded (Welcome, Event Invitation, Donation Receipt, Event Reminder). Create/Edit/Delete templates. Variable detection ({{name}}, {{member_id}}, etc.). Send with variable substitution.

financial_apis.details: Add API Connection dialog with Name, Provider (Stripe, PayPal, Flutterwave, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, QuickBooks, Xero, Custom), API Key, Secret Key, Webhook URL, Sandbox toggle, Active toggle.

gdpr_settings.details: Your Data Rights section (Export, Access, Erasure). Admin settings: Require Consent, Allow Data Export, Allow Account Deletion, Anonymize on Delete, Show Privacy Policy, Data Retention Period slider.

two_factor_auth.details: 2FA section in Settings > Security tab. Enable button visible. Setup generates QR code and secret. Verify with 6-digit code.

multi_language.details: Language dropdown in navbar shows: English, Luganda, Kiswahili, Espanol, Thai, Kreyol Ayisyen, Francais. Backend returns correct translations for lg (Luganda) and th (Thai).

navigation.details: Sidebar shows new sections: Analytics (Advanced Analytics, Reports & PDF, Report Builder, Campus Reports), Operations (Volunteer Scheduling, Email Templates), Admin (Staff Management, Campuses, Financial APIs, App Settings, Audit Trail, Privacy & GDPR, Settings)
